_comment: The campaign (docs/ROADMAP.md, Appendix E). An arc is a chapter; `act` groups chapters; `track` MAIN is the campaign and SIDE the trades' own arcs, one live step per track. `after` names the chapter that must be finished first. `giver` is the cast member who posts it (lore/config/cast.json). Every line is activity-neutral: an outing, never a ride.

acts.title: The Board
acts.description: Ada Pym keeps a board. Things go up on it and nobody comes. Then somebody does.

acts.title: Five More Cuts
acts.description: One rune read at a crossing is a start. There are five more on the roads round here, half-worn. Enid Sallow has the list.

acts.title: What Holds the Ground
acts.description: Legends have woken round here: big creatures that settle in and stay. Ada Pym has a few jobs to help you get the better of them.

arcs.title: First Light
arcs.description: Nobody starts out knowing the roads. They start by going outside, and then a little further than last time. Three outings, in order, and the map is no longer only the part you already knew.

quests.title: Out of the Door
quests.description: The hardest part of any outing is the first hundred metres. Take a way you have never taken, any way, as long as it is new to you, and the rest of the map starts to owe you something.
quests.completion: A way you had not taken. It is on the map now, in your hand.

quests.title: Something Green
quests.description: Every town keeps a green place, and most people pass the turning for years without taking it. Take it, then come home whichever way you like.
quests.completion: The turning was there all along. Now it has been taken.

quests.title: Somewhere to Look From
quests.description: Ground you have read looks different from above it. Climb to somewhere you can see it from, and the first light of this is done.
quests.completion: You looked down on it. It looked smaller, which was the point.

arcs.title: What Settles
arcs.description: A road used and not read goes vague, and things settle in the vague parts. Not wicked; in the way. There are a few on the board and nobody to send.

quests.title: Something in the Way
quests.description: One on the board with a name and a place. Go and find out what it wants, and give it that.
quests.completion: Seen off. The pin comes out of the board.

quests.title: A Box Nobody Came Back For
quests.description: A waywright buried it when the gate closed and did not come back. It is still there. Pass close enough and it is yours.
quests.completion: Opened. Whatever the waywright meant by it, it is in the book now.

quests.title: Three Patches
quests.description: Three patches of unread ground within reach. Go into each one. Reading them is most of the work.
quests.completion: Three patches read. Something had been settling in the middle one.

arcs.title: The Rune at the Crossing
arcs.description: Every road was written once, by people who cut a rune where two ways met. One of them has been found, and something has settled on it.

quests.title: Where Two Ways Met
quests.description: The map files it as old. Go and stand at it. Somebody meant something by it.
quests.completion: You stood where they stood. The map is still being polite about it.

quests.title: Write It Down
quests.description: Reading is the job. Go to the place, stop, and write down what is there in a few words. It counts for more than it looks.
quests.completion: Written down. A copy has been asked for.

quests.title: The One at the Crossing
quests.description: An old one has sat on the crossing long enough to think it owns it. It wants Raido, a loop cut with your track, and will take other things more slowly. Expect two outings.
quests.completion: Seen off. The crossing reads plainly again, which is all anyone wanted.

arcs.title: The Edge of the Map
arcs.description: A Wayfinder's map has an edge, and the edge moves. This is the work of moving it: out past the fog, into three unread places, and back with the shape of them.

quests.title: Past the Fog
quests.description: Ways you have never taken, and enough of them to be sure it was deliberate. The fog does not lift for someone who turns back at the first unfamiliar corner.
quests.completion: Past the last lamp and back. The edge is further out than it was.

quests.title: Three Unknowns
quests.description: One unread place is an accident. Three, on one outing, is a survey.
quests.completion: Three places that were rumours. Now they are places.

quests.title: And Back Again
quests.description: The edge is only moved once you can find your way home from it. Out to the far place, and back under your own navigation.
quests.completion: Out to the far place and home again. That is what moving the edge means.

arcs.title: What the Stones Remember
arcs.description: A Cutter reads the town as a text somebody else wrote: markers nobody explains, lines too straight to be accidents, ground older than the road on top of it.

quests.title: The Marker
quests.description: Somebody put it there and meant something by it. Stand at it, and write down what you think they meant.
quests.completion: The marker still explains nothing. You have a theory, which is more than most.

quests.title: The Straight Idea
quests.description: Three points on one bearing. Take them in any order. The line does not mind, but you will see it once you have.
quests.completion: Three points, one line. It was there before the streets were.

quests.title: Older Than the Road
quests.description: The surface is new. What it runs past is not. Find the old ground, and take a way there nobody has mapped for you.
quests.completion: Older than the road, and it knew it. You do too, now.

arcs.title: The Iron Hours
arcs.description: A Mender's arc is not about places. It is about the hours: covering the distance, paying a hill what it asks, and staying out after the interesting part is over.

quests.title: The Long Haul
quests.description: No hills to hide behind and no short cuts. Only the distance, at whatever pace keeps you going, and a little further than is comfortable.
quests.completion: Long one. Done.

quests.title: The Hill's Toll
quests.description: Every hill charges the same price and does not negotiate. Climb until it is paid.
quests.completion: Paid in full. The hill keeps no change.

quests.title: The Hour of Iron
quests.description: The last one is only time. Stay out in it, keep going, and come back having done the unremarkable thing well.
quests.completion: Out for the hours, back for tea. Nothing remarkable, done well.

arcs.title: A Record of Small Things
arcs.description: A Clerk's claim is that the small things are the record: one place looked at properly, three corners of a neighbourhood, a road nobody has written down.

quests.title: One Place, Properly
quests.description: Not a glance in passing. Stop, photograph it, and write the thing about it that a photograph does not carry.
quests.completion: One place, properly. One entry in the book.

quests.title: Three Corners
quests.description: A neighbourhood is not one place. Take its corners, and note what changes between them.
quests.completion: Three corners. Three entries. The neighbourhood is on paper.

quests.title: The Unwritten Road
quests.description: Ways you have never taken, surveyed rather than merely passed: the photograph, the note, and the distance to earn them.
quests.completion: Surveyed and written. The road is no longer unwritten.

arcs.title: The Cut of Kenaz
arcs.description: Kenaz. The torch. It shows what is there, which is not always welcome. Learn where it was, fetch what it needs, clear the ground, and cut it.

quests.title: Where Kenaz Was
quests.description: Kenaz was cut somewhere old round here. Go and stand where it was. The map is vague about which stone; so is everyone else.
quests.completion: You stood where Kenaz was cut. It was there; it needs doing again.

quests.title: Fetch and Carry
quests.description: Something to be taken from {poiName} to {carryToName}. What it is does not matter; that it went from one to the other does.
quests.completion: Carried. It is where it was meant to be, which is more than most things.

quests.title: Something in the Way
quests.description: Something has settled where Kenaz should be read. Give it what it wants.
quests.completion: Seen off. The ground is clear for the cut.

quests.title: Cut Kenaz
quests.description: A triangle with your track near a place worth showing. Three corners, and back to the first.
quests.completion: Kenaz, cut. It shows what is there, which is not always welcome.

arcs.title: The Cut of Ansuz
arcs.description: Ansuz. The word-rune. A place named is a place kept. Learn where it was, fetch what it needs, clear the ground, and cut it.

quests.title: Where Ansuz Was
quests.description: Ansuz was cut somewhere old round here. Go and stand where it was. The map is vague about which stone; so is everyone else.
quests.completion: You stood where Ansuz was cut. It was there; it needs doing again.

quests.title: Fetch and Carry
quests.description: Something to be taken from {poiName} to {carryToName}. What it is does not matter; that it went from one to the other does.
quests.completion: Carried. It is where it was meant to be, which is more than most things.

variants.description: Posted for whoever came home the other way last time. Something to be taken from {poiName} to {carryToName}; the other way will do again.

quests.title: Something in the Way
quests.description: Something has settled where Ansuz should be read. Give it what it wants.
quests.completion: Seen off. The ground is clear for the cut.

quests.title: Write Ansuz
quests.description: Go to the place, stop, and name it in a few words. That is the whole of the rune.
quests.completion: Ansuz, written. The place is kept.

arcs.title: The Cut of Wunjo
arcs.description: Wunjo. The glad rune. Roads were also for going somewhere pleasant. Learn where it was, fetch what it needs, clear the ground, and cut it.

quests.title: Where Wunjo Was
quests.description: Wunjo was cut somewhere old round here. Go and stand where it was. The map is vague about which stone; so is everyone else.
quests.completion: You stood where Wunjo was cut. It was there; it needs doing again.

quests.title: Fetch and Carry
quests.description: Something to be taken from {poiName} to {carryToName}. What it is does not matter; that it went from one to the other does.
quests.completion: Carried. It is where it was meant to be, which is more than most things.

quests.title: Something in the Way
quests.description: Something has settled where Wunjo should be read. Give it what it wants.
quests.completion: Seen off. The ground is clear for the cut.

quests.title: Keep Wunjo
quests.description: Five minutes somewhere pleasant, doing nothing in particular. It counts.
quests.completion: Wunjo, kept. Five minutes, and nothing came of it, which was the point.

arcs.title: The Cut of Sowilo
arcs.description: Sowilo. The sun. A road goes somewhere; this is the somewhere. Learn where it was, fetch what it needs, clear the ground, and cut it.

quests.title: Where Sowilo Was
quests.description: Sowilo was cut somewhere old round here. Go and stand where it was. The map is vague about which stone; so is everyone else.
quests.completion: You stood where Sowilo was cut. It was there; it needs doing again.

quests.title: Fetch and Carry
quests.description: Something to be taken from {poiName} to {carryToName}. What it is does not matter; that it went from one to the other does.
quests.completion: Carried. It is where it was meant to be, which is more than most things.

quests.title: Something in the Way
quests.description: Something has settled where Sowilo should be read. Give it what it wants.
quests.completion: Seen off. The ground is clear for the cut.

quests.title: Cut Sowilo
quests.description: Four legs, each turning back across the last. Easiest on foot.
quests.completion: Sowilo, cut. The road went somewhere; you were there.

arcs.title: The Cut of Dagaz
arcs.description: Dagaz. The day-rune. Dawn and dusk are the same mark seen from each side. Learn where it was, fetch what it needs, clear the ground, and cut it.

quests.title: Where Dagaz Was
quests.description: Dagaz was cut somewhere old round here. Go and stand where it was. The map is vague about which stone; so is everyone else.
quests.completion: You stood where Dagaz was cut. It was there; it needs doing again.

quests.title: Fetch and Carry
quests.description: Something to be taken from {poiName} to {carryToName}. What it is does not matter; that it went from one to the other does.
quests.completion: Carried. It is where it was meant to be, which is more than most things.

quests.title: Something in the Way
quests.description: Something has settled where Dagaz should be read. Give it what it wants.
quests.completion: Seen off. The ground is clear for the cut.

quests.title: Cut Dagaz
quests.description: Four sides, four turns the same way, and back where you began.
quests.completion: Dagaz, cut. Five more cuts, read and remade.

arcs.title: Habits
arcs.description: Before the big jobs, the good habits. Get out somewhere green, then go round for a cup of something.

quests.title: A Green Hour
quests.description: Spend a while somewhere green. The legends are not going anywhere.
quests.completion: A good hour. That is a habit worth keeping.

quests.title: The Coffee Loop
quests.description: A loop with a café on it. Every good journey has somewhere to stop.
quests.completion: Out, round and back, with a cup on the way. Ready for bigger things.

arcs.title: The Lair
arcs.description: Something has made a lair in a park near you. Visit its tiles and the great chest it keeps is yours.

quests.title: Visit the Lair
quests.description: There's a lair at {objectPlace}. Visit 5 of its 7 tiles before it ends.
quests.completion: The lair is yours, and so is its great chest!

arcs.title: The One That Stayed
arcs.description: One of the legends has settled in near you and has no plans to leave. Time to give it a good push.

quests.title: Give It a Push
quests.description: Do {legendDamage} damage to {legendName} on one journey. Find out what it's weak to first.
quests.completion: That got its attention!

arcs.title: Double Pay
arcs.description: Every day the board puts up a bounty that pays double. Take one, and you will have done everything Ada asked.

quests.title: Today's Bounty
quests.description: Today's bounty is the {objectName} at {objectPlace}. It pays double.
quests.completion: Bounty defeated, and paid twice over!
